theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pfi_c1_cutoff_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f O → ∃ (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ ∧ LipschitzWith Λ φ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, φ x = f x ∧ fderiv ℝ φ x = fderiv ℝ f x
